# Colart Digital Marketing Agency

> Full-service creative and digital marketing agency based in Tripoli, Lebanon, bringing branding, content, social media, and digital marketing together under one roof for businesses across Lebanon, the GCC, and beyond.

## Services

- [Brand Identity](https://www.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/services/#brand-identity): Logo design, brand identity systems, graphic design, and packaging design that give a business a distinct, consistent visual presence.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/services/#social-media): Content creation, content strategy, page management, copywriting, and monthly retainers to grow and engage a brand's social media audience.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/services/#digital-marketing): Paid ads, campaign strategy, performance tracking, and reporting built around targeted, data-driven digital marketing campaigns.
- [Media Production](https://www.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/services/#media-production): Photography, videography, and reels / short-form video production.
- [Website Development](https://www.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/services/#website-development): Custom website design and development.
- [Menu Hosting](https://www.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/services/#menu-hosting): Digital menus hosted at their own web address so guests can scan a QR code and browse a full menu on any phone. See live examples at [menus.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com](https://menus.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/).

## Location & Contact

Colart is based in Tripoli, Lebanon, and works with clients across Lebanon, the GCC, and beyond — most of the process (strategy calls, content reviews, campaign management) happens online, so location isn't a barrier to working together.
